name: event_id
description: eventId set by the authorization service; views deduplicate on it

name: event_type
description: user.created, user.logged_in, user.logged_out, password.changed, password.reset_requested or email.verified

name: event_ts
description: When the event was produced, in UTC; partition column

name: user_key
description: Pseudonym of the user: HMAC-SHA256 of the normalized username, joins with curated_movements.user_key

name: email_key
description: Pseudonym of the e-mail address: HMAC-SHA256 of the normalized address, under a purpose of its own

name: ip_prefix
description: Client network: the IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /48 that holds the address

name: attributes
description: Allowlisted fields of the event as JSON text (roles, methods, reasons)

name: hmac_key_version
description: Version of the HMAC key that produced user_key and email_key

name: source_file
description: Landing file the line came from

name: run_id
description: Pipeline run that wrote the row

name: ingested_at
description: Start of that pipeline run, in UTC
